mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, reducing the cost of capital and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month consecutive rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output, lowering corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening consumer confidence and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering Federal Reserve rate hikes that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market contraction, reducing household income and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), higher borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and consumer spending, lowering equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
